title: TSMC Stock (TSM) Falls 1.9% After Nvidia CEO Resignation (Nov 12)
summary: TSMC (TSM) closed at $405.49 on Nov 12, down 1.90%, as financial media tied the drop to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.
body_markdown:
The stock fell further than the broad market. The Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.39% to 25,366.09, the[S&P 500](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/sp-500-what-it-is-and-what-really-moves-it/) eased 0.35% to 7,592.40 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 0.36% to 52,297.09, leaving TSM 1.51 percentage points behind the Nasdaq.


Chip stocks moved in both directions.[Nvidia (NVDA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) fell 4.34%,[ASML](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/asml/) dropped 2.43% and Intel slipped 2.08%, while[AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) rose 5.86% and Broadcom gained 5.54%.


At the close, TSM stood 16.82% below its 52-week high of $487.47 and 51.97% above its 52-week low of $266.82.


## Why TSMC Stock Fell


According to[NVIDIA's announcement](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000082/nvidiaannouncesceotransiti.htm) on November 12, Jensen Huang resigned as president, chief executive officer and a member of the board, effective immediately. Chief financial officer Colette Kress agreed to serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor, and Nvidia shares closed down 4.34% that day.


Financial media tied TSMC's decline to the Nvidia news. As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tsmc-stocks-fall-2-21-180251979.html) , the shares fell in early trading as[Huang's departure](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-stock-falls-after-hours-huang-ouster-report/) hit the AI chip supply chain, two days after TSMC reported its biggest month ever.


Per[TSMC's October 2026 revenue report](https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/3349) , released on November 10, October revenue was approximately NT$586.89 billion, up 14.7% from September and 59.7% from October 2025. Revenue for January through October totaled NT$4,485.62 billion, up 43.3% from the same period in 2025.


## TSM Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Monthly sales growth: TSMC's October revenue rose 59.7% year over year to about NT$586.89 billion, according to the company.
- Year-to-date growth: revenue for the first ten months of 2026 was up 43.3% from a year earlier, per the same report.
- AI infrastructure spending:[Zacks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zacks-analyst-blog-highlights-ishares-134000412.html) cited IDC data showing global AI infrastructure spending of $121.4 billion in the second quarter, up 53.3% year over year.


### Risks


- Leadership change at Nvidia: Nvidia is led by an interim CEO while its board searches for a permanent one, and GuruFocus said the resignation hit the AI chip supply chain.
- Pressure on the AI trade: Zacks noted that investors are questioning valuations, whether hyperscaler capital spending can be sustained and how long returns on AI spending will take, with rising inflation and higher Treasury yields adding pressure.
- Sector swings: the iShares Semiconductor ETF fell 12.1% in the November 5 sell-off, according to Zacks.


GuruFocus pointed to TSMC's November sales report, which it expects in early December (an estimate, not a confirmed date), as the next data point for the stock.
